```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Generated;

use Money\Number;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class NumberGeneratedTest extends TestCase
{
    // ... existing tests ...

    #[Test]
    public function is_current_even_handles_string_digit(): void
    {
        $number = new Number('124');
        self::assertTrue($number->isCurrentEven());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function base10_positive_shift_on_integer(): void
    {
        $number = new Number('123');
        $result = $number->base10(2);
        self::assertSame('1', $result->getIntegerPart());
        self::assertSame('23', $result->getFractionalPart());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function base10_negative_shift_on_integer(): void
    {
        $number = new Number('123');
        $result = $number->base10(-1);
        self::assertSame('12', $result->getIntegerPart());
        self::assertSame('3', $result->getFractionalPart());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function base10_positive_shift_on_decimal(): void
    {
        $number = new Number('123', '45');
        $result = $number->base10(1);
        self::assertSame('12', $result->getIntegerPart());
        self::assertSame('345', $result->getFractionalPart());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function base10_negative_shift_on_decimal(): void
    {
        $number = new Number('123', '45');
        $result = $number->base10(-1);
        self::assertSame('1234', $result->getIntegerPart());
        self::assertSame('5', $result->getFractionalPart());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function base10_with_zero_shift_returns_same_number_for_non_zero(): void
    {
        $number = new Number('123', '45');
        $result = $number->base10(0);
        self::assertSame('123', $result->getIntegerPart());
        self::assertSame('45', $result->getFractionalPart());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function base10_with_zero_shift_returns_zero_for_zero(): void
    {
        $number = new Number('0');
        $result = $number->base10(0);
        self::assertSame('0', $result->getIntegerPart());
        self::assertSame('', $result->getFractionalPart());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function base10_negative_number_positive_shift(): void
    {
        $number = new Number('-123');
        $result = $number->base10(1);
        self::assertSame('-12', $result->getIntegerPart());
        self::assertSame('3', $result->getFractionalPart());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function base10_negative_number_negative_shift(): void
    {
        $number = new Number('-123');
        $result = $number->base10(-1);
        self::assertSame('-1230', $result->getIntegerPart());
        self::assertSame('', $result->getFractionalPart());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function round_money_value_rounds_up_when_digit_is_five(): void
    {
        $result = Number::roundMoneyValue('123.45', 1, 2);
        self::assertSame('123.5', $result);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function round_money_value_rounds_up_with_carry_over(): void
    {
        $result = Number::roundMoneyValue('123.95', 1, 2);
        self::assertSame('124.0', $result);
    }
}
```
